title: 2-D shapes
examples: How many corners does a square have?
Can you show me a triangle?

explain.say: Look at this shape. Can you see the straight lines? These straight lines are called sides.
The points where the sides meet are called corners. Let us count the corners together now.
A circle is a shape with no straight sides or sharp corners at all.
A triangle has three straight sides and three pointy corners. It looks like a little roof.
A square has four sides that are all the same length. It also has four perfect corners.

faq.q: How do I know if a shape is a square or a rectangle?
faq.a: A square must have all four sides exactly the same length. A rectangle only needs two pairs of equal sides.
asks: What is the difference between a square and a rectangle?

faq.q: Does a circle have any corners?
faq.a: No, a circle has no straight sides and it has no corners at all. It is perfectly round.
asks: Can you point to the corners of a circle?

faq.q: What is the easiest way to count the sides?
faq.a: You can trace along every straight line until you get back to where you started. Count each line you trace.
asks: How do I count the sides?

faq.q: Do all triangles have the same size?
faq.a: No, triangles can be big or small. They must always have exactly three sides and three corners.
asks: Can a triangle have four sides?
What is the rule for triangles?

faq.q: If I see a shape with four sides, how do I know if it is a square?
faq.a: You must check if all four of those sides are exactly the same length. If they are, it is a square.
asks: How do I check for a square?

facts: A circle has no straight sides and no corners.
A triangle always has three sides and three corners.
A square has four sides that are all the same length.
A rectangle has four sides, but only opposite sides are equal.

quiz.say: Which shape has four equal sides and four corners?
quiz.why: A square is special because all four of its sides must be the same length.

wrong.0: A rectangle only needs two pairs of equal sides, not all four.
wrong.1: A triangle only has three sides, not four.
wrong.2: A circle has no straight sides or corners at all.

quiz.say: How many sides does a triangle have?
quiz.why: By definition, a triangle is a shape made up of three straight sides.

wrong.0: Zero sides would mean it is not a shape at all.
wrong.2: Two sides make a straight line, not a closed shape.
wrong.3: Four sides make a square or rectangle.

quiz.say: If a shape has four sides but they are not all the same length, what is it?
quiz.why: If the sides are not all equal, but it still has four straight sides, it is a rectangle.

wrong.1: A square requires all four sides to be perfectly equal.
wrong.2: A triangle cannot have four sides.
wrong.3: A circle does not have any straight sides at all.
